reproduction.actual_trigger: After string_decoder, one Home NAPI CLI build reaches missing http, while MDX CLI reaches undefined tty.WriteStream.prototype. Missing HTTP stays unsupported; no import-only module is added.
reproduction.before: Both providers fail a real PTY constructor probe with zero output bytes. Node/Bun controls write actual UTF-8 and report the independently configured93x27 kernel size.
reproduction.after_each_home_provider: 29/29 groups and119/119 pinned Node environment cases execute in each of two actual PTYs; Python sets93x27 and47x11 independently and compares all41 UTF-8/NUL/0xff/ANSI bytes.
reproduction.native_implementation: Read-only ioctl size queries; managed Writable delegates to real descriptor writes and owns a /dev/fd copy. Existing FS ownership closes it exactly once. Kernel descriptor counts rise by one during ownership and return to baseline after close, with the caller fd still a terminal. Private query/factory hooks are deleted.

color_source.source: Node v26.10.0 internal/tty.js through the installed pinned runtime; MIT/FSF notices retained in tool_tty.js
color_source.scope: POSIX environment rules; Windows query refuses support. The119-row matrix regenerates byte-exactly with pinned Node.

reproduction.limits: Default options only; constructor requires a real POSIX terminal. Read/raw input, non-terminal constructors, option objects and automatic SIGWINCH watching remain unavailable. Explicit _refreshSize queries the kernel; no automatic resize event is simulated. No full CLI, HTTP, N-API/Rust build or upstream-test pass is claimed.
reproduction.references: Node passes29+119 and both physical windows. Bun full reference fails24/29 groups in its first window with five API differences; its119 colors,41 bytes and first size match, but second-window execution is unexecuted. The smaller initial Bun physical constructor probe passes.
reproduction.retained_harness_failures: Initial PTY drain closed the last slave too early on macOS and lost queued bytes; keeping the parent slave open fixes the independent harness. Initial Node expectations of a public fd field and ERR_STREAM_DESTROYED after end were wrong; Node exposes no fd there and returns ERR_STREAM_WRITE_AFTER_END. Initial expectation that Node closes the caller fd was also disproved: actual Node retains it. All raw failures remain; final behavior follows the executed reference.
